entities.name: Andy Cruz Gómez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andy Cruz Gómez is a Cuban professional boxer. He has won two gold medals at the Pan American Games, three gold medals at the AIBA World Championships, and a gold medal at the 2020 Tokyo Summer Olympics.
